h7WarfareHavenBallista.description:
The Haven's Ballista, which fires heavy bolts.

H7 Warfare Unit: when a Haven hero has received the Ballista slot token at the H7 Memorial Blacksmith and has Artillery, it replaces the original Ballista at the start of combat (level: Basic Artillery 2, Advanced 3, Expert 4; level 5 with Artillery, Engineering and First Aid together, and Reaper Arts from Undead King counts as all three). When it dies, the original Ballista is lost too.

h7WarfareHealingSister.description:
The Haven's Healing Sister, who tends allies' wounds on the battlefield.

H7 Warfare Unit: when a Haven hero has received the First Aid Tent slot token at the H7 Memorial Blacksmith and has First Aid, it replaces the original First Aid Tent at the start of combat (level: Basic First Aid 2, Advanced 3, Expert 4; level 5 with Artillery, Engineering and First Aid together, and Reaper Arts from Undead King counts as all three). On level 5 her healing can also resurrect. When she dies, the original First Aid Tent is lost too.

cast.description:
{Sister Healing}
Heals a living ally by level: 38/75/113/188.

h7WarfareHavenCatapult.description:
